dialogue.origin: こんにちは。今日は１時間よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for joining me for this one-hour session today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、宜しくお願いします(thankyou)(shiny)
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. I appreciate it.(thankyou)(shiny)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどんなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 今、引きこもりなんです。
dialogue.content: Right now, I'm a shut-in.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 不登校で、学校に行ってません
dialogue.content: I haven't been going to school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。何年生ですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. What grade are you in?

dialogue.origin: 高1です。
dialogue.content: I'm a first-year in high school.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。学校に行けないと辛いですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see. It must be tough not being able to go to school...

dialogue.origin: はい、しんどいです
dialogue.content: Yes, it's tough.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。どういう時が一番しんどいとお感じですか？
dialogue.content: I can imagine. When do you feel it's the hardest?

dialogue.origin: まず学校に行けなくて、友達が離れてしまった事です
dialogue.content: First, it's that I can't go to school, and my friends have drifted away.

dialogue.origin: ええ、友達と疎遠になるのは悲しいですね・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, it's sad to grow distant from your friends...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何か、連絡をとったりもしていない状況なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are you not keeping in touch at all?

dialogue.origin: はい。仲良かった友達と、同じ高校に行けたのに、時間差登校で関われなくなり
dialogue.content: Yes. I was able to go to the same high school as my close friends, but staggered attendance meant I couldn't interact with them.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 決められたグループの中に、友達が居なくて
dialogue.content: My friends weren't in the assigned group.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 1ヶ月、気が合わないメンバーと一緒でした
dialogue.content: For a month, I was with members I didn't get along with.

dialogue.origin: それは、気疲れしてしまいますね・・・
dialogue.content: That must have been mentally exhausting...

dialogue.origin: はい、疲れてしまいました
dialogue.content: Yes, I got exhausted.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねなかなか打ち解けるのは難しかったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like it was difficult to open up to them.

dialogue.origin: コロナで気をつかうどころか、うるさいメンバーで疲れましたね
dialogue.content: Far from being considerate because of COVID, they were a loud group, and it wore me out.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・せっかく学校まで行っても、楽しいどころか辛かったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see… Even when you managed to go to school, it wasn’t enjoyable—it was painful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 僕は昔から周りに気をつかうタイプなので、全然違う性格について行けなかった
dialogue.content: I've always been the type to be considerate of others, so I couldn't keep up with their completely different personalities.

dialogue.origin: ええ、心が休まらない人たちの中で緊張もありましたね・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, you must have been tense around people you couldn't relax with...

dialogue.origin: はい、新しい環境に馴染めなかったです
dialogue.content: Yes, I couldn't adapt to the new environment.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。全く違った環境のスタートでそれでなくても大変なのに
dialogue.content: I understand. Starting in a completely different environment is hard enough as it is.

dialogue.origin: 分散登校も今までにない出来事ですしね
dialogue.content: And staggered attendance is something we’ve never experienced before, too.

dialogue.origin: はい。もう無理って感じです。
dialogue.content: Yes. I feel like I can't do it anymore.

dialogue.origin: 友達は別のグループに馴染んでしまったし
dialogue.content: My friends have fit in with other groups, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは寂しいですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see. That must be lonely...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 学校以外で会うことも難しいですしね・・・
dialogue.content: And it's difficult to meet outside of school, too...

dialogue.origin: 今はなんか距離置かれた感じもあって、こっちからは連絡し辛いです
dialogue.content: Right now, I feel like they’re keeping their distance, so it’s hard for me to reach out.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 裏切られた様な、悔しい気持ちもあります
dialogue.content: I also feel kind of betrayed and frustrated.

dialogue.origin: ええ、それは苦しいですよね。。。
dialogue.content: Yes, that must be very painful...

dialogue.origin: 初めて一人って言う孤独を経験しました
dialogue.content: I experienced the loneliness of being truly alone for the first time.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ひとりで虚しいと感じておられるのですね
dialogue.content: You feel empty being alone, don't you?

dialogue.origin: はい。また昔の様にもとに戻りたいとは思いますが、、、
dialogue.content: Yes. I do want things to go back to how they used to be, but…

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.origin: 騒がしいタイプのグループに馴染んでるので、そこへは入りたく無いんです
dialogue.content: They've fit into a noisy group, and I don't want to join them there.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ノリが違うとどうしても違和感がありますよね
dialogue.content: I see. When the vibe is different, it definitely feels out of place.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今までのお友達はどんな話題で気が合うお友達だったのですか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of topics did you and your friends connect over before?

dialogue.origin: 日常的な事だったり、家庭の話しとか、凄く理解してくれたので、信頼してました
dialogue.content: We talked about everyday things, things about our families... they were very understanding, so I trusted them.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。何気ないお話ができて安心できたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You felt safe being able to have those casual conversations.

dialogue.origin: はい、支えになっていたんだと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I think they were a source of support for me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。そのお友達を失ったかもと思うと余計に心が痛みますよね・・・
dialogue.content: I see. Thinking you might have lost those friends must hurt even more...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですか・・・今、ご家族はどのように受け止めてくださっている感じですか？
dialogue.content: I see… How is your family taking this right now?

dialogue.origin: 母一人なので、朝早くから夕方遅くまで仕事で、なかなか話しが出来ないです
dialogue.content: It's just my mom, and she works from early in the morning until late in the evening, so we don't really get to talk.

dialogue.origin: 迷惑かけたく無いから、話して来なかったです
dialogue.content: I didn't want to be a burden, so I haven't told her.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。心配をかけまいと・・・
dialogue.content: I see. You’ve been trying not to worry her…

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・お母さんにとっては頼もしい息子さんとして振舞っていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: I see... So you've been acting as a reliable son for your mother.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: とても尊敬します。
dialogue.content: I really respect that.

dialogue.origin: 晩御飯も僕が作ったり、お風呂も入れるとか、家庭の手伝いはやって来ました
dialogue.content: I've been helping around the house, like making dinner and preparing the bath.

dialogue.origin: なんていい息子さんでしょう！しっかりとお母さんをサポートしてきたのですね。
dialogue.content: What a wonderful son! You've been supporting your mother so well.

dialogue.origin: それは全く苦には思わないけど、やっぱり友達と関わらない事が辛いんです
dialogue.content: I don't mind that at all, but not being able to interact with friends is what's painful.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。家での自分と、外での自由な自分がいてほしいですよね。
dialogue.content: That's right. You want to have your home self and a free self outside.

dialogue.origin: 皆んな夕方遅くまで自由で、、、いいなと思ってしまいます
dialogue.content: Everyone else is free until late in the evening... I can't help but feel envious.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, that's understandable...

dialogue.origin: 友達が、僕をもっと気遣ってくれると思っていたけど、
dialogue.content: I thought my friends would be more considerate of me, but—

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: そんな家庭環境には、もう合わせたく無いんだなと思ってしまいます
dialogue.content: I feel like they don't want to accommodate my family situation anymore.

dialogue.origin: ええ、期待を裏切られたとお感じなんですね・・・
dialogue.content: Yes, you feel like your expectations were betrayed...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そう考えると悲しくなってしまいますね・・・
dialogue.content: Thinking that way must make you sad...

dialogue.origin: 一つ質問してもいいですか？
dialogue.content: May I ask you a question?

dialogue.origin: 孤独感、凄いです
dialogue.content: The loneliness is overwhelming.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: うん、誰かにわかってほしいですよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, you want someone to understand, don't you?

dialogue.origin: 質問です
dialogue.content: Here is my question.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ５年後、１０年後、何をしていたいとか、夢はありますか？
dialogue.content: In five or ten years, what would you like to be doing? Do you have any dreams?

dialogue.origin: 人の役に立ちたいと思います
dialogue.content: I want to help people.

dialogue.origin: おお！
dialogue.content: Wow!

dialogue.origin: どんな風にでしょう？
dialogue.content: In what way?

dialogue.origin: 一人で頑張る母の姿を見てるので、何かしらの人のサポートがしたいです
dialogue.content: I've seen my mother working so hard on her own, so I want to support people in some way.

dialogue.origin: ええ、いいですね。お母さんにとって、とか、もう少し具体的に自分ならこれができそう、というのはありますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, that's wonderful. Can you be a bit more specific? For example, for your mother, or something you think you could do?

dialogue.origin: でも、それって介護になるのかな、、、今はまだ介護って言う夢は無いんですが
dialogue.content: But, would that be something like caregiving... I don't really have a dream of being a caregiver right now.

dialogue.origin: はい。色々なサポートの形がありますよね。
dialogue.content: Right. There are many ways to support people.

dialogue.origin: どんなものがあるのか、まだ知らないです
dialogue.content: I don't know what kinds of things there are yet.

dialogue.origin: 介護だと、だいぶご年配の方々が対象ですが、保育士なら子ども相手だし
dialogue.content: For example, caregiving often involves working with the elderly, whereas a childcare worker works with children.

dialogue.origin: それには学校へ通わないとですよね？
dialogue.content: I'd have to go to school for that, right?

dialogue.origin: 食材の宅配なんかも人助けでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Delivering groceries could also be a way of helping people, don't you think?

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい被ってしまいました
dialogue.content: Sorry, I spoke over you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、いろんな可能性があると思いますが
dialogue.content: Yes, I think there are many possibilities.

dialogue.origin: 学校退学して、別の学校へ通う事も母に相談する勇気が無くて
dialogue.content: I don’t have the courage to talk to my mother about withdrawing and going to another school.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 学校をどうするか、という相談をしようとお考えなのですね
dialogue.content: So you're thinking about talking to her about what to do about school.

dialogue.origin: はい。今の学校は、体が震える程、拒絶しているから。
dialogue.content: Yes. My body trembles at the thought of my current school; I reject it that much.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: お母さんに、友達のことを話していないとおっしゃっていたので
dialogue.content: You mentioned you haven’t told your mother about your friends,

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: どうにかして話せればいいな、とは感じていました
dialogue.content: I was thinking it would be good if you could find a way to talk with her.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 学校へ行っていないことはお母さんはご存知ですか？
dialogue.content: Does your mother know that you haven’t been going to school?

dialogue.origin: そろそろバレると思います
dialogue.content: I think she’s about to find out.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: とても勇気がいりますね
dialogue.content: That will take a lot of courage.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 転校をお考えということは高校をしっかり卒業しようとお考えなのですよね
dialogue.content: Considering transferring means you intend to properly graduate from high school, right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、そこは最後まで頑張らないと世の中出れない気がして
dialogue.content: That's right. I feel like I won't be able to make it in the world if I don't see that through to the end.

dialogue.origin: はい。安心しました。
dialogue.content: Yes. I’m relieved to hear that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんにも、その意識があることをまずお話になるといいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: It might be a good idea to first tell your mother that you have that intention.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、ため息出ますが
dialogue.content: You're right. It makes me sigh, though.

dialogue.origin: はい。。それから、お友達との辛かったことも、素直にお伝えできるといいと思います
dialogue.content: Yes... And then, I think it would be good if you could also honestly share the painful things about your friendships.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうします
dialogue.content: Okay, I'll do that.

dialogue.origin: お母さんは、どういう風に反応しそうですか？
dialogue.content: How do you think your mother might respond?

dialogue.origin: 悲しむと思いますね
dialogue.content: I think she’ll be sad.

dialogue.origin: たぶん、自分を責めるタイプの母なので
dialogue.content: She’s probably the type to blame herself.

dialogue.origin: 悲しむ・・・ええ、なるほど・・・
dialogue.content: Sad... yes, I see...

dialogue.origin: お母さんのせいって、思ってます？
dialogue.content: Do you think it’s your mother’s fault?

dialogue.origin: 母では無くて家庭環境ですね
dialogue.content: Not my mother, but our family situation.

dialogue.origin: もし普通の家庭だったら、、、と何度も思ってきました
dialogue.content: I’ve often thought, if only we were a ‘normal’ family…

dialogue.origin: ええ、確かに。
dialogue.content: Yes, I can see that.

dialogue.origin: でも、お母さんのために家事をしてあげて
dialogue.content: But you’ve been doing housework for your mother, and—

dialogue.origin: 父が居ないから、どうしても僕が支えにならなきゃと自分を犠牲にしてきました
dialogue.content: Because my father isn’t around, I've sacrificed myself, feeling like I absolutely have to be her support.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・・友達はみんな遊んでいるのに・・・
dialogue.content: I understand... while all your friends are out having fun...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんとは話す時間がないとのことですが、そこら辺のことはお母さんは何かおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you don’t have time to talk with your mother—has she said anything about that?

dialogue.origin: 短い時間で、色々聞いては来ますが僕が逃げてきたのかもしれないです
dialogue.content: She does ask me various things in the short time we have, but I think I might have been running away from it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・本音を出すと傷つけてしまいそうで怖かったんですね
dialogue.content: I see... You were afraid that revealing your true feelings might hurt her.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、もう我慢の限界という感じではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: But doesn’t it feel like you’re at your limit now?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、焦りますね
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: ここで私の感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be all right if I shared my impressions with you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今、高校にも行けなくて孤独をお感じでいるのはとても伝わってきました
dialogue.content: It's very clear to me that you're unable to go to high school and are feeling very lonely.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 自分なりに転校を考えて、状況をよくさせたいともお考えで、建設的で素晴らしいと感じます
dialogue.content: I also find it wonderful and constructive that you're thinking about transferring on your own to improve your situation.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 自分が友達と遊ぶ時間を削ってまでお母さんを支えてきて、とてもいい息子さんだとも感じています。
dialogue.content: I also feel you’ve been a very good son, supporting your mother even at the cost of time with your friends.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その大事なお母さんを思うあまり、自分が高校に馴染めなくて辛いことも言えず、やせ我慢しているんだな、とも感じています
dialogue.content: And I feel that because you care so much about your mother, you can't tell her how much you're struggling with not fitting in at school, and you're just putting on a brave face.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんを心配させないために「言わない」のではなく、全部辛さも何もかも伝えてしまうことが
dialogue.content: Instead of "not telling her" to avoid making her worry, telling her everything, all the pain and all...

dialogue.origin: 本当の、親孝行で、お母さんの思いは「いつも聞いてくる」ことからも、「あなたをわかりたい」のではないかと
dialogue.content: ...would be the truest way to be a good son. And from the way she always asks, I think what she really wants is to understand you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたの孤独は、一番近くにいるはずのお母さんが一番理解してくれることではないかと感じました。
dialogue.content: I felt that your loneliness is something your mother, who should be closest to you, would be the one to understand best.

dialogue.origin: もちろん、男として、高校生としてのプライドはあると思うのですが
dialogue.content: Of course, you have your pride as a young man and as a high school student.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s true.

dialogue.origin: 2人きりの、大事な家族なんですよね？これから先も長い人生、わかり合うにはいいタイミングではないですか？
dialogue.content: You're an important family of two, aren't you? With a long life ahead, isn't this a good time to come to an understanding?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうだと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.origin: いかがですか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: はい、凄く為になりました。言って行く事を恐れていましたが、母と今度話し合ってみたいと思えました。
dialogue.content: Yes, this was very helpful. I was afraid to tell her, but now I feel like I want to try talking it over with my mom.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。よかったです具体的にどう伝えるかですが
dialogue.content: I see. I'm glad to hear that. As for how to tell her specifically...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんが心配性で自分を責めるタイプ、とおっしゃっていたので
dialogue.content: You mentioned your mother is a worrier and tends to blame herself,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんのせいじゃないよ、という前置きと、高校は卒業したいんだ、という意思表示ですね
dialogue.content: It would be good to preface it by saying, "This isn't your fault," and also stating your intention that you want to graduate from high school.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そうですね！それなら傷付けないで話せそうです
dialogue.content: I see, yes! That way I can probably talk without hurting her.

dialogue.origin: 実際に学校へ行けなくなった期間や友人関係のことなどありのままにお話ししてみて
dialogue.content: Try to share honestly about the period you haven't been able to go to school and what’s been happening with your friendships.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 学校の先生に相談しようという話になるかと思いますが、
dialogue.content: The conversation will probably turn to consulting a teacher at school, but

dialogue.origin: そこが辛いですが、
dialogue.content: That part will be hard, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 時間が随分と過ぎてしまいましたが、、、
dialogue.content: A lot of time has passed, but...

dialogue.origin: まずは、お母さんと、最善の方向を探ってみてください
dialogue.content: First, try to find the best path forward with your mother.

dialogue.origin: すみません。もう時間ですね。失礼しました。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. It looks like our time is up. My apologies.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。いい話し合いが出来る様に頑張ってみます
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right. I'll do my best to have a good talk with her.

dialogue.origin: はい、良い方向に向かえるように心から祈っています。がんばってください。では、今日はここまでとさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll be hoping from the bottom of my heart that things move in a good direction. Please do your best. Well, we'll end here for today.

dialogue.origin: はい、有難うございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.
